title: Dihedral Attractors
description: Rung 4 of the geometric-energy ladder: sculpt meshes by optimizing functionals over triangulation dihedral angles — flatness, uniform folds, creasing, smoothness, or fold entropy — with points free or pinned to a sphere, torus, or saddle.

seo.title: Dihedral Attractors — Sculpting Geometry by Optimizing Fold Angles
seo.description: An interactive lab that minimizes or maximizes energies built from the dihedral angles of a live triangulation, coaxing point clouds into folded, curvature-defined attractors reminiscent of the Platonic solids.
